articles.title: Trump at Davos, Netflix earnings, SCOTUS hearing: What to Watch
articles.mainIdea: Trump at Davos, Netflix earnings, SCOTUS hearing: What to Watch
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: Trump at Davos, Netflix earnings, SCOTUS hearing: What to Watch. Market Domination Overtime Host Josh Lipton previews several of the biggest stories to come next week, including earnings results from companies like Netflix (NFLX), Procter & Gamble (PG), and United Airlines (UAL); President Trump's attendance at the 2026 World Economic Forum (WEF) in Davos, Switzerland; the US Supreme Court's (SCOTUS) hearing on whether the Trump administration has the power to remove Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook; and November's reading on the Personal Consumption Expenditures index (PCE). To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination Overtime.
